note: Look library. 'prompt' is injected into every render prompt; 'avoid' goes to the model's negative prompt when it has one, otherwise into the prompt. Descriptions are user-facing. Studio and artist names are deliberately not used.

styles.name: Auto: match my references
styles.description: Follow the look of your character and set sheets exactly.
styles.prompt: Match the visual style of the reference images exactly: the same rendering technique, character design, proportions, colours and level of detail.
styles.avoid: a different art style from the references

styles.name: Feature animation 3D
styles.description: Polished, expressive characters, rich lighting and detailed worlds, the look of big-screen animated features.
styles.prompt: High-end 3D animated feature film style: appealing stylized characters with expressive faces and large eyes, soft subsurface-scattered skin, detailed hair and fabric, rich global illumination, cinematic depth of field, polished art-directed environments.
styles.avoid: photorealistic humans, live-action footage, flat 2D shading, low-poly models

styles.name: Stylized 3D
styles.description: 3D characters with deliberately simplified or exaggerated shapes, from cute to dramatic.
styles.prompt: Stylized 3D animation: deliberately simplified, exaggerated character shapes and proportions, bold graphic silhouettes, clean readable forms, painterly textures, strong art-directed colour.
styles.avoid: photorealism, realistic human proportions, live-action footage

styles.name: Cel-shaded 3D
styles.description: 3D animation rendered to look hand-drawn, with flat colour and ink outlines.
styles.prompt: Cel-shaded 3D animation: 3D characters and sets rendered with flat toon shading, crisp ink outlines, limited shadow tones and a hand-drawn comic finish.
styles.avoid: soft realistic shading, photorealism, painterly blur

styles.name: Photorealistic CGI
styles.description: Digital characters and environments designed to resemble live-action footage.
styles.prompt: Photorealistic CGI: physically accurate materials, realistic skin pores and hair, natural lighting and lens behaviour, indistinguishable from live-action cinematography.
styles.avoid: cartoon proportions, cel shading, illustrated look, plastic skin

styles.name: Low-poly 3D
styles.description: Faceted, geometric 3D with a clean modern-game feel.
styles.prompt: Low-poly 3D style: faceted geometric characters and environments, flat-shaded polygons, clean gradient lighting, minimal textures.

styles.name: 2.5D animation
styles.description: Flat artwork arranged in layers in 3D space: depth with an illustrated look.
styles.prompt: 2.5D animation: flat illustrated artwork arranged on layered planes in 3D space, parallax camera moves revealing depth, painted textures that remain two-dimensional.

styles.name: Traditional hand-drawn 2D
styles.description: Characters redrawn frame by frame, with fluid lines and expressive changes in shape.
styles.prompt: Traditional hand-drawn 2D animation: pencil-and-ink line art with subtle line boil, hand-painted cel colours, painted watercolour backgrounds, fluid squash-and-stretch, animated on twos.
styles.avoid: 3D render, CGI shading, photorealism, vector-perfect lines

styles.name: Digital 2D
styles.description: Drawn characters and backgrounds made digitally: can mimic traditional or look crisp and modern.
styles.prompt: Modern digital 2D animation: clean confident line work, flat colour with soft digital shading, crisp illustrated backgrounds, smooth motion.

styles.name: Anime-inspired
styles.description: Distinctive character design, cinematic framing and expressive key poses, from quiet holds to intense action.
styles.prompt: Anime-inspired 2D animation: clean line art, cel-shaded characters with expressive eyes, detailed painted backgrounds, dramatic cinematic framing, lighting effects and lens flares, expressive key poses with quiet held moments.
styles.avoid: 3D CGI look, photorealism, western cartoon proportions

styles.name: Western TV cartoon
styles.description: Bold shapes, clear expressions and efficient, often exaggerated movement.
styles.prompt: Western TV cartoon style: bold simple shapes, thick clean outlines, flat bright colours, clear exaggerated expressions, snappy efficient animation.

styles.name: Rubber-hose cartoon
styles.description: Bouncy vintage cartoon motion with flexible limbs, rounded forms and musical timing.
styles.prompt: 1930s rubber-hose cartoon style: rounded characters with bendy tube limbs and white gloves, bouncy rhythmic motion timed to music, vintage film grain, limited muted palette.
styles.avoid: modern digital look, realistic anatomy, 3D render

styles.name: Limited animation
styles.description: Carefully chosen poses and selective movement: the body holds while the face, hands or camera move.
styles.prompt: Limited animation: strong held key poses, selective movement of faces, hands, hair and camera while bodies stay still, graphic flat backgrounds.
styles.avoid: full fluid body animation, 3D render, photorealism

styles.name: Painterly / watercolour
styles.description: Moving paintings: visible brushwork, soft washes and textured paper.
styles.prompt: Painterly animation: every frame looks hand-painted, visible brushstrokes and watercolour washes on textured paper, soft edges, luminous colour.

styles.name: Afrofuturist illustration
styles.description: Bold graphic illustration mixing African pattern, colour and futurism.
styles.prompt: Afrofuturist illustrated animation: bold graphic shapes, rich African textile patterns and colour, luminous gold and jewel tones, stylized futuristic architecture, confident poster-like composition.
styles.avoid: photorealism, muted desaturated palette, generic sci-fi chrome

styles.name: Rotoscope
styles.description: Animation traced from filmed movement: realistic motion with an illustrated surface.
styles.prompt: Rotoscoped animation: realistic human motion and timing traced into illustrated line art, flat colour fills with slight frame-to-frame line wobble.

styles.name: Motion comics
styles.description: Comic panels brought to life with camera moves, layered depth and limited character movement.
styles.prompt: Motion comic: inked comic-book panels with halftone shading, layered cut-out depth, slow camera pans and pushes, limited character movement, bold comic colouring.

styles.name: Cutout animation
styles.description: Flat characters built from movable pieces, paper or digital.
styles.prompt: Cutout animation: flat characters assembled from jointed paper or card pieces, visible edges and textures, puppet-like jointed movement.
styles.avoid: smooth 3D render, photorealism, fluid drawn animation

styles.name: Stop motion
styles.description: Physical objects photographed frame by frame, with a tactile, handmade quality.
styles.prompt: Stop-motion animation: handcrafted physical puppets and miniature sets, real fabric and material textures, practical lighting on miniatures, slightly stepped frame-by-frame movement.
styles.avoid: smooth CGI motion, digital perfection, photorealistic humans

styles.name: Claymation
styles.description: Sculpted clay characters with soft forms and visible material texture.
styles.prompt: Claymation: characters sculpted from plasticine clay with visible fingerprints and tool marks, soft rounded forms, miniature handmade sets, stepped stop-motion movement.

styles.name: Puppet animation
styles.description: Articulated physical puppets with fabricated costumes, faces and sets.
styles.prompt: Puppet stop-motion animation: articulated puppets with sculpted replacement faces, tailored miniature costumes, detailed handmade sets, warm practical lighting.

styles.name: Paper cutout stop motion
styles.description: Physical paper shapes animated on a flat surface or layered miniature set.
styles.prompt: Paper cutout stop motion: layered coloured paper and card shapes with torn edges and paper grain, shallow miniature depth, frame-by-frame movement.

styles.name: Brick-toy stop motion
styles.description: Building-brick figures and sets: playful, modular and visibly physical.
styles.prompt: Brickfilm stop motion: minifigure-style characters and sets built from plastic building bricks, glossy plastic surfaces, modular architecture, stepped stop-motion movement.

styles.name: Diorama / miniature
styles.description: Miniature-looking characters and environments with a small-world feel.
styles.prompt: Miniature diorama look: tiny handcrafted world with tilt-shift shallow focus, model-scale props and figures, soft practical lighting.

styles.name: Paint-on-glass
styles.description: Paint changed directly between frames, creating flowing, dreamlike transformations.
styles.prompt: Paint-on-glass animation: oil paint smeared and reworked frame by frame, fluid dreamlike transformations between images, glowing backlit colour, visible paint trails.

styles.name: Sand animation
styles.description: Sand reshaped frame by frame: fluid silhouettes and a transient, textured look.
styles.prompt: Sand animation on a backlit glass table: images drawn in sand, granular silhouettes and textures, fluid morphing transitions, warm monochrome light.

styles.name: Silhouette animation
styles.description: Dark figures against contrasting backgrounds, emphasizing shape, gesture and atmosphere.
styles.prompt: Silhouette animation: characters as solid black cut-paper silhouettes against luminous coloured or gradient backgrounds, expressive gesture and profile, shadow-puppet elegance.

styles.name: Mixed media
styles.description: Combines methods, such as 3D characters in painted 2D backgrounds, or collage.
styles.prompt: Mixed-media animation: stylized 3D characters composited into hand-painted 2D backgrounds with collage textures and paper elements, deliberate contrast between techniques.

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.description: Retro video-game pixels with limited palettes.
styles.prompt: Pixel-art animation: low-resolution sprite characters and tiled backgrounds, crisp square pixels, limited retro colour palette, stepped sprite animation.
styles.avoid: smooth gradients, anti-aliased lines, 3D render, photorealism

styles.name: Motion graphics
styles.fit: Best for lyric or graphic videos
styles.description: Animated typography, icons, shapes and graphic layouts driven by the music.
styles.prompt: Motion-graphics style: bold flat shapes, icons and graphic layouts animated in rhythm, clean vector design, strong colour blocking.

styles.name: Whiteboard animation
styles.fit: Best for lyric or explainer videos
styles.description: Drawings appear as they're being made; common in educational videos.
styles.prompt: Whiteboard animation: black marker line drawings appearing stroke by stroke on a clean white board, occasional single accent colour.

styles.name: Cinematic live action
styles.description: Looks filmed with real actors and a cinema camera.
styles.prompt: Cinematic live-action footage: real actors and locations, shot on a cinema camera with anamorphic lenses, natural skin texture, filmic colour grade and grain.
